title: Codex Pet V2 Spritesheet Format — 1536×2288 | Codex Pet Lab
description: Reference for the Codex Pet V2 8×11 spritesheet: 192×208 cells, nine animation states, and 16 clockwise look directions.
text: Format reference Codex Pet V2 Spritesheet Format V2 extends the original nine-row Codex pet atlas with two complete look-direction rows. The final WebP is exactly 1536×2288 pixels. Atlas geometry Columns: 8 Rows: 11 Cell width: 192 pixels Cell height: 208 pixels Final size: 1536×2288 pixels Rows 0–8: standard states 0 idle 1 running-right 2 running-left 3 waving 4 jumping 5 failed 6 waiting 7 running or active work 8 review Rows 9–10: look directions The 16 cells form one clockwise sequence in 22.5-degree steps. 000 means up, 090 means screen-right, 180 means down, and 270 means screen-left. row 9: 000, 022.5, 045, 067.5, 090, 112.5, 135, 157.5 row 10: 180, 202.5, 225, 247.5, 270, 292.5, 315, 337.5 Transparency and unused cells Unused cells in standard animation rows should remain fully transparent. Avoid backgrounds, cast shadows, labels, guide marks, detached effects, and content crossing into neighboring cells.
